title: Claude Code expands with 5 MCP servers #claudecode #mcpservers #aiworkflow
description:
Claude Code becomes significantly more powerful with five MCP servers that expand it beyond a closed coding assistant into a live research, browser automation, and multimodal workflow tool.

Perplexity MCP adds real-time internet access inside Claude, Playwright lets it control a browser and test web apps, Firecrawl pulls entire websites into conversations for research and RAG, Glyph connects it to large networks of image and video generation models, and Chrome MCP links Claude to the tabs already open in Chrome.

Together, these MCP servers show how the Model Context Protocol is turning AI tools into connected operating layers for development, automation, and content workflows. The practical value is speed: less context switching, better live data access, deeper web interaction, and broader creative output directly inside Claude-based setups.

#ClaudeCode #MCP #ModelContextProtocol #PerplexityMCP #PlaywrightMCP #Firecrawl #Glyph #ChromeMCP #ClaudeAI #BrowserAutomation #RAG #AIWorkflows #WebAutomation #AIAgents #PromptEngineering
transcript: Stop using Claude Code if you don't know about these five MCP servers yet. Start with Perplexity MCP. It gives Claude live internet access directly inside your workflow. Next is Playwright. This lets Claude control a browser, test apps, upload files, and interact with websites automatically. Then there's Firecrawl. It can crawl entire websites and load the content directly into your conversation for research or rag workflows. After that comes Glyph. It connects Claude to hundreds of image and video generation models while optimizing prompts automatically. And finally, Chrome MCP. Inside Claude Code, it allows Claude to interact with whatever you currently have open in Chrome. If you want to check them out by yourself, just comment MCP and I'll send you the links.
